messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts for /v1/generate across prod-us-west and prod-eu-1. Spike started ~1807504300. Alert group: infra-errors. Paging @emma (primary oncall) and @raj (serving).

emma: ack — I'm looking. seeing 5xx rate ~18% on prod-us-west at the moment. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc123/prod-errors (don't paste externally).

raj: also seeing a sharp increase in 429s earlier at ~1807504100 then 5xx followed. looks like quota enforcement flipped for a global quota rollout? checking quota-service logs now.

michael: I'm getting traces showing gateway timeout to model-hosts pool A (tokio/gRPC timeouts). leader reports: high queue depth, many connections in CLOSE_WAIT.

leah: @emma can you confirm if any deploys went out in last 20m? I see a config push to quota-rollup at 1807504055 by automation-bot.

emma: no manual deploys from me. @ops-bot did a config apply?

ops-bot: automation: applied config "quota-rollup-v2" to staging and prod (prod rollout: 100%) at 1807504055. Change: consolidated per-customer quotas into a global bucket.

raj: that matches. we're seeing customers exceeding new global bucket thresholds; quota-service returns 429 -> upstream callers start retrying quickly -> saturates gateways -> 5xx and timeouts. classic quota-bleed cascade.

emma: mitigation path: 1) rollback quota-rollup to previous config 2) temporarily relax global quota limits 3) enable per-tenant bypass for high-traffic enterprise customers 4) scale up gateway pool. Which is fastest?

raj: fastest is to flip the rollout rollback OR set feature-flag to disable global quota enforcement. I can flip the feature flag in 2 min. rollback of config might take longer and risk rollout loops.

michael: scaling gateway pools will help but takes 5-7m for instances to warm and won't stop retries hammering backends. need immediate throttle relax or bypass.

leah: I'll open an emergency change to disable enforcement. patch preview:```curl -X POST https://control-plane/api/flags/quotas/enabled -d '{"enabled":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}'```

emma: go ahead leah. raj, coordinate the flag flip and I'll watch prod metrics and error rate. notify support for customer comms after we have stable baseline.

raj: flipping flag now...

ops-bot: action: feature-flag quotas/enabled set to false by raj at 1807504402.

emma: seeing immediate drop in 5xx percentage in prod-us-west, 5xx down from 18% to 4% in last 90s. 429s also dropping. Grafana panel: error_count per minute trending down.

michael: connection queues draining. model-hosts pool latency returning to normal. I'm still seeing some residual timeouts for in-flight requests but p50/p95 improving.

leah: rolling a targeted restart of quota-service replicas to ensure no stale enforcement rules. command:```kubectl rollout restart deploy/quota-service -n platform --selector=canary!=true```

emma: proceeding to scale gateways by +30% as precaution. tagging scaling as temporary.

sarah: CS here — starting customer triage list. Notifying top 10 customers that had spikes: cust-47, cust-12, cust-enterprise-acme. Will send holding notice stating degraded degraded latency and that mitigation is in progress.

emma: good. post any customer-visible status updates to status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-1807504321.

raj: feature-flag rollback confirmed stable. I'm going to begin a controlled re-rollout to 10% after we validate. will set circuit-breaker to per-tenant enforcement for 10% group only.

ops-bot: quota-service replicas restarted by leah at 1807504520.

michael: monitoring: p95 token latency back to baseline, error budget burn rate returning to normal. no downstream DB errors observed.

emma: thanks team. next steps: - leave flag disabled for 10m while we validate - gather logs for postmortem (quota-service decisions & rollout automation) - prepare rollback timeline to revert to config-based per-tenant quotas and add a canary that exercises heavy traffic profiles.

leah: capturing artifacts: logs archived to s3://infra-archives/incidents/1807504321/ with request traces and quota-service dump.

raj: I'll create an issue linking the automation script that applied the policy and add stricter rollout gates. Also adding a test harness that simulates concurrent quota bursts.

sarah: CS will follow up with personalized notices to impacted accounts and link to status page. If any customers escalate to legal, route to enterprise ops.

emma: handing off to night on-call @michael in 30m. I'll stay available for 1hr for follow-ups. michael, summary: flag disabled -> errors reduced -> replicas restarted -> scale gateways +30% -> collect artifacts -> controlled 10% canary if stable.

michael: ack and thanks. I'll watch overnight and update if error rate creeps above 2% for more than 5m. I'll also schedule a short postmortem sync tomorrow 10:30 PT.

incident-bot: incident update logged: INC-1807504321 created and assigned to oncall. Postmortem owner: raj.

emma: closing pager for now, leaving channel open for followups. :white_check_mark:
